description: Per-file completeness/status tracker. Score=100 means fully implemented, tested, and verified with no known gaps. score=null means UNREVIEWED -- a placeholder added 2026-06-30 for full-repo .py coverage tracking, not a real assessment; do not treat null as 0 or as 'broken'. TBI = ToBeImplemented (placeholder/spec is known, code is not written). TBD = ToBeDetermined (design question still open, no spec yet). Warnings = anything flagged for attention that isn't a TBI/TBD. Coverage: all 387 .py files in the repo have an entry (16 reviewed with real scores/evidence from the 2026-06-29/06-30 HDP v2 + 4-object pipeline session, 374 unreviewed placeholders). Non-.py files (configs, notebooks) are added selectively, not exhaustively. Do not backfill a null score without actually reviewing the file -- a fabricated number is worse than an honest null.
meta_corrections: 2026-06-30: Every full-suite test run before this correction was launched as `pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -20`, which silently truncated the FAILED-test list to whatever fit in the last 20 lines before the summary line. This session repeatedly reported '29 pre-existing failures, identical list, no regressions' across Phase 0/1/2/3a -- that claim was only ever checked against ~19-20 of the real 30 failures, never the complete set. A full untruncated run (grep '^FAILED' on raw output, no tail) found: (1) test_public_api_snapshot_v034.py was failing because of MY OWN Phase 3a change (4 new __all__ names not reflected in the frozen snapshot) -- a real regression I introduced and missed, now fixed by regenerating the snapshot; (2) 3 more call sites of the removed default_spectrolaminar_config function (test_etude1_agsdr_convergence.py, and critically the published tutorial notebook etudes/jaxfne_etude_no_1_base.ipynb) that were never previously identified; (3) 2 unrelated test_neuronal_tensor.py failures from a second consequence of the same archival (legacy-schema JSON in a directory a test assumed was tensor-only); (4) 1 fully unrelated pre-existing hygiene-check failure. Lesson: never pipe a verification run through `tail`/`head` when the claim being made is about completeness of a list -- truncation silently turns 'no regressions found' into 'no regressions found in the last 20 lines', which is a materially different and weaker claim. CONFIRMED FIXED 2026-06-30: a second complete run after the fix shows 29 failures (was 30), exact same remaining list as documented in entries[] -- regeneration worked, nothing else regressed.

function_merger_analysis.description: 2026-06-30: repo-wide AST scan for function-merger candidates (pattern: y1=f1(x1), y2=f2(x2), same output identity, incomparable inputs -> merge into y3=f1(x1,x2)). Method: parsed all 387 .py files via Python's ast module, extracted every function/async function with an EXPLICIT return type annotation (1182 functions; unannotated functions excluded -- no fabricated type inference), grouped by exact annotation string match. 96 distinct return types were shared by 2+ functions; most are false positives (coincidental generic types like dict[str, str]/Any/bool shared by unrelated functions). Verdict on the strongest candidates, each individually checked against actual source, not just the type-match heuristic:
function_merger_analysis.real_candidate: build_model/apply_drive_correction -> Model: jaxfne/hdp_network.py's OWN docstring claims it consolidated this exact duplicate pattern from 2 older scripts, but scripts/hdp_1000_neuronal_tensor_column.py, scripts/hdp_suite2_visualizations.py, and scripts/spectrolaminar_tfne_izhikevich_pipeline.py still have their own un-migrated copies the original consolidation missed. Tracked as planned item merge-build_model-apply_drive_correction.
function_merger_analysis.already_solved_confirmed: construct(cfg_or_tensor, runtime=None) in core.py is ALREADY the merged form of the Configuration-path and NeuronalTensor-path Model construction (dispatches via isinstance) -- this is the user's exact merge pattern, already implemented, not a gap.
function_merger_analysis.investigated_and_rejected: simulate_edge_recurrent_izhikevich{,_homeostatic,_hdp,_receptor_exponential} (4 kernels, same output shape) -- this is the exact five-way dispatch problem already audited in this session's Phase 2 work and confirmed NOT cleanly mergeable (different jax.lax.scan carry shapes per mode).
false_positives_confirmed: load() vs load_neuronal_tensor(): load_neuronal_tensor is already a literal 1-line compat alias of load() -- not a duplicate.
EmitterState.initial_state/step (x2 each): two classes implementing the same Protocol/interface -- intentional polymorphism, not duplication.
module-level run_trials/run_receipt vs Model.run_trials/run_receipt methods: standard free-function + thin-delegating-method pattern already used throughout this codebase, not duplicated logic.

step_{agsdr,gsdr,gsgd,sdr}_transform (4 optimizer steps, identical signature): inputs are actually COMPARABLE (same shape already), not incomparable -- already a clean strategy pattern behind OptimizerSpec; merging would add indirection without removing real duplication (did not verify internal logic for true duplication, only the signature).
function_merger_analysis.limitation: Only functions with explicit `-> Type` annotations were scanned (1182 of an unknown larger total). Functions relying on inferred/implicit return types are NOT covered by this pass -- absence from this analysis does not mean a function has no merge candidate, only that it wasn't checked.
